pr_title: fix(platform-brower): fire Animations events & set animation properties when using async animations
pr_body:
2 closely related commits : 

* Animations events registered against the default renderer were'nt registered against the animation renderer once it was loaded. 
* Animations properties set on the default renderer weren't set on the animation renderer once it was loaded.

fixes #52076

issue_context.title: Animations events not firing when using provideAnimationsAsync
issue_context.body:
When trying the new `provideAnimationsAsync` API in the Angular Material demo app, I noticed a regression in the sidenav whose root cause is that the `@.start` and `@.done` events won't be bound to elements that are present before the animations module has loaded. Since the Angular Material sidenav is likely to be present on init and because [it binds the events inside host bindings](https://github.com/angular/components/blob/main/src/material/sidenav/drawer.ts#L152), it's extremely likely that it won't be able to bind the events which in turn breaks the entire component since it depends on those events firing.

**Proposal:** this issue could be resolve by tracking the pending event listeners in memory before the module is loaded and adding them as soon as loading has completed.
